results.title: Boatwright debuts strong as Gilas routs Syria in FIBA World Cup qualifiers
results.content: New naturalized Filipino Bennie Boatwright and star center Kai Sotto live up to the hype as Gilas Pilipinas pummels Syria to kick off its fifth-window campaign in the 2027 FIBA World Cup Asian qualifiers

results.title: The coral reef watchers saving our ocean
results.content: Filipino marine scientists and volunteer divers work together to keep an eye on coral reefs — a collective pursuit in protecting the country's marine environment
